Product Manager for Workflow Tools

Fictional Pebble Workspace

FICTIONAL JOB DESCRIPTION FOR APP TESTING

Improve an internal workflow product by understanding user problems, choosing outcomes and collaborating with engineering.

REQUIRED

- Conduct discovery and translate evidence into prioritized problems.

- Define product outcomes and interpret activation and retention metrics.

- Design experiments and explain uncertainty and guardrails.

- Negotiate scope and technical tradeoffs with engineering.

- Communicate roadmap decisions and learn from results.

NICE TO HAVE

- Ability to inspect data with SQL.

- Experience with internal enterprise tools.

INTERVIEW STAGE

Hiring manager interview about product judgment and evidence.
